explanation_full: Based on the available metrics, the Random Forest (RF) model appears to be the most robust performer among the tested models. It achieved a high R2 score of 0.7756 and a strong correlation of 0.88511. Furthermore, its Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0836 is quite low, indicating consistent prediction accuracy. While the maximum absolute residual was 0.450808, the overall metrics suggest that RF provides a reliable and accurate prediction capability for this dataset.
